activity_type.description:
Filter to only receive certain activity types.

It is possible to filter multiple types: Example: `activity_type={type1}&activity_type={type2}`

items.title: BizActivityType
items.description:
Type of activity sent in on IntreeBusiness web.

- `generic`: generic notification from intree

- `new_partner_treet`: a partner has shared a treet with the business
- `new_multiple_partner_treets`: multiple treets are shared from one partner
- `new_partner_added`: a new partnership is created
- `new_team_member`: a new team member is added
- `new_biz_application`: a new application is received
- `new_biz_owner`: ownership has been transferred
- `new_group_application`: a new group application is received
- `treet_expires_soon`: a treet is about to expire
- `treet_redeem_limit_hit`: a treet has hit its redeem limit
- `treet_share_limit_hit`: a treet has hit its share limit
- `new_reported_member`: a member has been reported
- `thread_activity`: a new thread with comment has been made on a business post
